en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a train with several carriages and wagons standing on tracks in a snowy mountainous landscape. To the right is a wooden railway building or signal house with a steep roof. Snow covers the ground and rocky foreground, with a large snow‑covered mountain ridge in the background. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom margin.
